questions.question: Does MarocVows take a booking commission?
questions.answer: No. Users contact providers directly and confirm commercial terms with the provider.

questions.question: Are all provider listings verified?
questions.answer: No. Some profiles have verified details and others are clearly marked as unverified. Users should confirm all important details before booking.

questions.question: Which cities does MarocVows currently cover?
questions.answer: The public directory currently includes providers in Khénifra, Fès and Meknès.
